title: Evidence anchors, records, stores and notifications
description: STANDARD v1.2 §6.5 and §6.6. EvidenceAnchor restates schemas/event_schema.yaml#/types/Anchor (1.2.0) in Draft 2020-12; tests check that the two agree. EvidenceRecord is what an evidence store keeps and exports, one per line of a JSON Lines export. StoreInfo is what a store states about itself. EvidenceRecorded is the notification a host MAY send when it stores evidence records, a canonical event or audit records; it is not a record and may be delivered at most once. No member of any of them holds a secret (§6.7).

ref.description: Where the evidence is. Opaque, except the reserved scheme acs: (a workflow value).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 time at which the producer read or observed the evidence.

excerpt.description: A short quotation of the evidence as read; never a secret.

EvidenceAnchor.description: An evidence anchor. Other members may appear; a producer's own should start with x-.

Digest.description: SHA-256 of the content as the producer read it (for a JSON value, of its RFC 8785 canonical JSON in UTF-8).

run_id.description: The run (STANDARD v1.2 §5.19) or, for a call, the scope of the safety layer (§5.18).

frame.description: For a step, the workflows of its nested runs, root first.

step.description: For a step, its index in the last workflow of frame.

tool.description: For a call, the name the host offers the tool under.

call_id.description: For a call, the host's identifier of the call.

recorded_at.description: ISO-8601 time at which the store kept the record.

metadata.description: What the implementation keeps beside the anchor; never a secret.

bounded.description: The store removes records before their retention ends to stay within a size.

removed.description: Records the store removed other than by their retention: evicted to stay within a size, or cleared. Record ids are never reused.

action_ids.description: The audit records stored, by their ActionRecord action_id (STANDARD v1.2 §6.4).

anchors.description: The anchors of what was stored; for audit records, their own anchors, possibly none.
